chapter: Fletcher as a leader and early bandmates
title: Benny Carter's deceptive smile and thorough rehearsals
summary: Carter is a gentleman whose smile can be deceiving; he rehearses like Don Redman, drawing everything out of a band.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Yeah, I'm sure of that. One thing I've always noted about Benny Carter whenever I've seen him or talked with him, that he always seems to be such a gentleman. He just -- you know, he's always got that smile on his face. You'd never know even for sure what he's thinking or how he's feeling or whatever because he looks -- he just comes across so nicely that way. Is he always that way?
Sometimes that smile can be deceiving, you know?
That's what I've wondered, you know.

He's very thorough in rehearsal of the band. He's another Don Redman. When he rehearses a group, they are well rehearsed. He gets out of you all you've got. but he knows how to explain what he wants...

It meant exactly -- you've got the difference between the two smiles if you've worked with Benny. But he was a thorough musician, and he's another genius. I admire him tremendously and we are very good friends.
